summary: Extract the first principal component of the zebrafish structural-predictor matrix, reshape it into a region-by-region structural PC1 matrix, sign-align it to functional connectivity, and measure how strongly it predicts FC with an edge-wise Pearson correlation over the upper triangle.
use_when: Analyze structural pc1 as a predictor of functional connectivity
Generate structural pc1 as a predictor of functional connectivity outputs
avoid_when: The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
A low-dimensional embedding alone would be treated as confirmatory statistical evidence
Connectivity estimates are unsupported because sampling, preprocessing, or matrix alignment is inadequate
